Document text extraction. layout and embedded images are not reproduced.

Working paper #1 In continuation of previous mindmap of the semantic analysis (inserted here again for the sake of good order): Why we do it What it involves of activities What we want to come out of it (awareness) Enhance Experiment (AM’s) Showcase (provoke) Scrutinize Research Reflections (debate/dialog) Understand Harvesting [mining] Behavior [change] Thinking Investigate Consider [usefulness] Reflect Produce [funding] Expose [findings, publish] Challenge Develop [products] Consequences [next step] The Foundation's purpose: management, visibility and partnerships Projects: planning and staffing etc. Communication: debate and dialogue with the audience … including about the 18. UN goals … I have expanded it to the next phase: What is the problem we want to solve – and how will we do it? 1st Actions Issues Involves How to …   2nd actions (take) Responsibility Knowledge Transfer The Mind Future Fond (identify) Problems History Innovation Partnerships (find) Data/facts Science Sharing Book of Mindsets (change) Thinking Capacity Learning Educate/inform (expose) Ignorance Beliefs Dogmas Provoke/debate (fight) “Truth’s” Mental Information Provoke/events (make) Solutions Politics Economy Engage/partners (discuss) Fear/hope Feelings Social behavior Vision statement (execute) New models Interaction Communication Debate/blog Repeat/evolve Very basically, I have thought about what the world's biggest problems are (issues) and what it takes for us to solve them (involves and how to …)? We have exchanged an extremely large number of emails and links as inspiration and fact-findings; I attach them in a separate document. After the last meeting we have the tasks: The Book of Mindsets I have developed a small model as an overall overview: Is it self-explanatory? The blog Only identified can initiate topics/questions to the blog. Anyone can ”chat” with AM’s and get answers.
